```plato

    // The eliminated right-hand side of equation j.
    SweepValue(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => j <= 1
            ? self.SweepRight(1) / self.SweepDiagonal(1)
            : (self.SweepRight(j) - self.SweepBelow(j) * self.SweepValue(j - 1)) / self.SweepPivot(j);
```
